notes.title: 2.7.3 Released - Skydiving, Zombie Mode & Processors
notes.content:
2.7 is almost complete, we now can turn into zombies (after you've been infected) sky dive, and process ore and other materials into new and more useful materials.

Up next is god/admin mode, bug fixes, map additions and a few surprises.  Stay tuned.


Change Log
---


engine: upgraded to unreal engine 4.19.2
new: parachute added - allows for falling from great heights
new: zombie mode - can revive as a zombie if (a: body is intact, and b: body is 100% infected)
new: zombie meat - cooked and uncooked, does damage if you eat it, but increases your infection level
new: human meat - cooked and uncooked, only zombies like to eat this
new: pig meat - cooked and uncooked, really high food content
new: launchers now fire missiles again
new processors - converts resources into other resources. Each processor has 3 types which use fuel and processes at different rates
Food Processors (fire, large fire and cooking station) - turn raw meat into meat
Ore Processor ( furnace, huge furnace, efficient furnace) - turns ore/scrap into metal/gold
Oil Processor (Oil Refinery, Oil Refinery Huge, Oil Refinery Efficient) - turns oil into gas.
new: new inventory transfer screen allows for grid placement of inventory items
bugfix: palm tree and crate meshes now correct
tweak: free players on mobile can now get to level 10
tweak: most food give less food now that we have cooked foods
tweak: zombies more faster
tweak: when repairing an item, it will lose a level

notes.title: 2.6.0.10243 (Beta 5) has been released for both PC & Android
notes.content:
This build cleans up a lot of bugs with the new vehicles as well introduces how the new vehicles will become stronger.

New blocks have been added 

http://i.imgur.com/joXjhfY.gif

XP Block - hit a vehicle with this to give it experience.  As the vehicle levels up, it will gain more MAX hit-points.  If the vehicle is capable of being armored, it will gain more MAX armor hit-points.

Armor Block - hit a vehicle with this block to add armor HPs.  This will increase the total HP of a vehicle.  Note: if you boost while driving your vehicle, it will not go against your armor HP.

- these new blocks will drop on npc kills, a special block that is 100x more effect will drop from bosses (more on that later)

- more V2 door upgrades - bakery, mini-mall, stripclub

- tweaks to zombie AI and spawner logic.  Zombie now hear you if you are running/moving near them.  They will come and investigate.

- aircraft/planes now use mouse input to change your direction

http://i.imgur.com/uyLD3XO.gif

notes.title: 2.6.0.10241 (Beta 4) has been released for both PC & Android
notes.content:
Cleaned up the UI, addressed some frustrations I've seen on lets plays & made progress on turreted vehicles

http://i.imgur.com/HZgwlzp.gif
http://i.imgur.com/9BFpeXy.gif

- new: military vehicle turrets - free mouse on pc, touch & drag screen on mobile
- new: armor items now have a "equip" button in the inventory - armor tab was where this was done before
- new: consumable items now have a "consume" button in the inventory  - using the item with left mouse button from hotbar (use button on mobile) was how done before
- new: boost added to all vehicle types
- bugfix: starvation damage no longer goes against armor HP, affects HP directly
- bugfix: character reaction now different if its damage against hp, armor hp and starvation damage
- bugfix: weight was reported incorrectly between side bar and full info stats
- tweak: changed speed reduction of being overweight/out of energy to 50/60% instead of 10/20%, as that wasnt fun for people
- tweak: changed jump blocking weight from ideal weight (yellow) to red - so you can jump when slighly overload - for the fun
- tweak: alerts on why you cant jump, i.e. energy or weight issue

notes.title: 2.5.0 Released - the "things to do" release
notes.content:
The major goal of 2.5 is to create more things to do in the game - the 3 major parts are new NPCs, dungeons, and a reason to go into the dungeons (scaled gear).  More dungeons will be added soon.

	Unreal Engine: 4.15.1
	---------
	
		new: new npc types (bandits, more zombies, pigs) 
		new: dungeons - first dungeon The Hospital has been introduced.  More to come real soon.	
		new: inventory screen and equip screen - split out into different tabs)
		new: npcs now have levels, 1-255
		new: weapons and armor now have levels 1-255
		new: armor also has TIERS, ie. a tier 1 hat (i.e a baseball cap) is worse than a tier 4 hat (i.e military hat)
		new: dungeon browser tab added to map
		new: spawn point screen updated
		new: random spawn accounts for level of you vs the spawn points, ie. wont put newbs in level 200 land
		new: new AI system, enemies engage in different ways depending on type.
		new: settings window - sound levels can now be managed
		new: host menu - game host can now adjust name of game and host settings from within the game.
		new: PC version very close - if you buy pro on android, email service@bitporters.net your GPA# and I will give you a steam key (i.e. GPA.XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXX)
		new: dash screen has quick buttons to chat options + selfie cam for screenshots.
		new: pre-launch game settings window, can now adjust amount of zombies/survivors/bandits/animals
		
		bugfix: better in game crash reporting
		tweak: upgrade to unreal 4.15
		tweak: when a weapon/armor breaks, it doesn't dissapear, it just becomes unusable/doesnt grant protection
		tweak: more brains granted if you share the game on social media, thank you for supporting this game.
		tweak: NPC spawner only spawns specific NPCs at specific times of the day
		
		android: only pro accounts can buy brains
		android: buying pro unlocks all the game modes
		translations updated
	
	
Full change log here - www.bitporters.net/zta/change_log.html
